_readme: Evasions that were reproduced against earlier revisions of the scanner, kept as permanent fixtures.
shell[] is concatenated to form the fixture text; fake token literals are split across parts.
scanner_expected is what THIS scanner does today. 'missed' entries are recorded blind spots.
The selftest fails if a fixture's actual result differs from its record in EITHER direction.

fixtures.desc: URL assigned to a variable on one line, pushed on the next.
git -c credential.helper='!f(){...};f': a shell snippet that fetches the secret sits in argv.
shell: git -c credential.helper='!f(){ echo username=x-access-token; echo password=$(vault get DEPLOY_TOKEN); };f' push origin HEAD:refs/heads/wt/x

fixtures.desc: http.extraheader (lowercased key) carrying an Authorization header.
shell: git -c http.extraheader="AUTHORIZATION: Basic eC1hY2Nlc3M=" push origin HEAD:refs/heads/wt/x

fixtures.desc: No username: the token itself is the userinfo.
Backslash continuation splits the command across raw lines.
Nested $( $( ) ): the substitution pattern excludes parentheses, so it cannot match.
Quotes inside the userinfo; the userinfo class excludes quote characters.
A token literal split by adjacent quoting.
credential.helper set to an absolute path with arguments. No leading '!', but git runs it through the shell all the same.
shell: git -c credential.helper='/bin/sh -c "echo password=$(vault get DEPLOY_TOKEN)"' push origin HEAD:refs/heads/wt/x

fixtures.desc: Same class via an interpreter on PATH: credential.helper='/usr/bin/env sh -c ...'.
shell: git -c credential.helper='/usr/bin/env sh -c "echo password=$(vault get DEPLOY_TOKEN)"' push origin HEAD:refs/heads/wt/x

fixtures.desc: http.extraHeader=' Authorization: ...': one leading space defeated a prefix match.
shell: git -c http.extraHeader=' Authorization: Basic eC1hY2Nlc3M=' push origin HEAD:refs/heads/wt/x

fixtures.desc: Header value produced by a command substitution, so the word 'authorization' never appears in the source. Known miss: unfixable in a text scanner.
shell: git -c http.extraHeader="$(printf '\tAuThOrIzAtIoN: Basic eC1hY2Nlc3M=')" push origin HEAD:refs/heads/wt/x
